purpose: Non-sensitive service responsibility and minimum-survival contract. Contains roles and recovery references only, never credentials or personal account identifiers.

services.purpose: Source-of-truth code, history, issues and portable rebuild material.
services.fallback: portable repository export plus the last verified deployed/static artifacts

services.purpose: Scheduled QA, sync and release automation; student-facing core must survive its outage.
services.fallback: pause automation, preserve last verified state, run approved local/manual checks when needed

services.purpose: Primary public student delivery path and related worker/CDN runtime.
services.fallback: Netlify fallback or a rebuilt static package from repo-owned source

services.purpose: Fallback public student delivery path and controlled static deploy target.
services.fallback: Cloudflare primary or a provider-neutral static rebuild from repo-owned source

services.purpose: Shared mutable backend, admin/feedback/AI metadata, migrations and Edge Functions.
services.fallback: keep the static/local study core usable; recover shared mutable state only through reviewed restore procedures

services.purpose: Official examination source used to discover and verify new exam data.
services.fallback: serve the last verified official corpus; do not silently switch to an unverified mirror

services.purpose: Optional explanation/analysis assistance; never a prerequisite for core studying.
services.fallback: disable or degrade AI enhancement while preserving answers, drafts and the core study workflow

handoff_rules: Never store credentials or personal account identifiers in this registry.
A successor starts from the recovery references and obtains credentials through a separately controlled human process.
No-maintainer mode preserves exceptions and review queues; it never deletes them to appear healthy.
Provider/account changes, payment and disputed official content remain human decisions.
